-- test: health json single pod --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} health -o json
-- expect:jsonpath --
pods.0.name == {{pod}}
-- expect:jsonpath --
pods.0.data.status == UP
-- expect:jsonpath --
pods.0.data.components


-- test: health yaml single pod --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} health -o yaml
-- expect:stdout --
pods:
-- expect:stdout --
status: UP
-- expect:stdout --
name: {{pod}}


-- test: health json multi-pod is one document --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --deployment {{deployment}} health -o json
-- expect:jsonpath --
pods.0.data.status == UP
-- expect:jsonpath --
pods.1.data.status == UP


-- test: env json applies filter --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} env --filter spring.application -o json
-- expect:jsonpath --
pods.0.data.propertySources
-- expect:stdout --
spring.application.name
-- expect:not:stdout --
java.version


-- test: logger json shows configured levels --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} logger -o json
-- expect:jsonpath --
pods.0.data.loggers.ROOT.configuredLevel == INFO


-- test: metrics json detail with tag --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} metrics jvm.memory.used --tag area=heap -o json
-- expect:jsonpath --
pods.0.data.name == jvm.memory.used
-- expect:jsonpath --
pods.0.data.baseUnit == bytes


-- test: beans json applies filter --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} beans --filter testScheduled -o json
-- expect:jsonpath --
pods.0.data.contexts.test-actuator-app.beans.testScheduledTasks
-- expect:not:stdout --
testActuatorApplication


-- test: threaddump json applies state filter --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} threaddump --state TIMED_WAITING -o json
-- expect:jsonpath --
pods.0.data.threads.0.threadState == TIMED_WAITING
-- expect:not:stdout --
RUNNABLE


-- test: metrics list json applies filter --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} metrics --filter jvm.memory -o json
-- expect:stdout --
jvm.memory.used
-- expect:not:stdout --
jvm.threads.live


-- test: structured output reports pod errors in envelope --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod nonexistent-pod-12345 health -o json
-- expect:error --
not found in namespace
-- expect:jsonpath --
pods.0.error
-- expect:stdout --
"data": null
-- expect:stderr --
not found in namespace
